description: Set or remove the picture of ONE category. Pass a public https image link in url (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB; a bigger file is refused, there is no resize) — Obriym stores its own copy and the previous picture is deleted only after the new one is in place. Pass url: null to remove the current picture. Idempotent in effect: repeating it leaves the same picture. Use list_categories to find the category id. The result echoes the workspace.

anyOf.description: A public https image link (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB). Obriym downloads it and stores its own copy in the workspace, so the link may be temporary.

url.description: A public https image link (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB) to use as the category picture, or null to remove the current picture.

name: set_category_image
title: Set category image
